faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you book

questions.q: How do I book a yacht charter on Boat4You?
questions.a: Browse yachts available for charter within your chosen destination for your selected charter dates and simply click the Reserve button of your preferred yacht. We will then confirm availability with the charter partner, send you a booking proposal and, once you have paid the deposit, your charter will be confirmed and you can start looking forward to your charter!

questions.q: Do I need a sailing license to charter a yacht?
questions.a: When booking bareboat yachts (no skipper) you need to hold a valid sailing licence recognised in the country where you want to charter a boat (Croatian boat licence or similar, RYA Day Skipper, ICC or other). In case you don’t hold a valid sailing licence you can always book any boat and then book a skipper for an additional fee via checkout.

questions.q: What is included in the bareboat charter rate?
questions.a: The base rate for your charter yacht covers the yacht itself, its standard equipment for use on board, the support of your charter agency, and insurance against major damage. End cleaning, fuel, out of homeport mooring, transit log and tourist tax (if applicable) usually will be charged separately, however. These items are always clearly indicated as obligatory or optional for each yacht on the detail page for said yacht.

questions.q: Can I charter a yacht without a skipper?
questions.a: Yes. Bareboat charters are available on the majority of the yachts listed on this website, provided at least one person on board holds a current and recognised sailing licence together with a VHF licence. If no one in your group has a sailing licence, you can still charter the same yacht with the services of a qualified skipper for an additional daily charge.

questions.q: When is the best time to charter a yacht in the Mediterranean?
questions.a: The best time for sailing is in May, June and September. The sea is warm, the wind is light, there are not too many people on the islands and coast, and prices are noticeably lower than in July and August. In April and October it is even possible to go on a sailing trip as a confident sailor, although the sea is a bit cooler. In these months you will even get the lowest weekly prices of the year.

Cancellation policies differ from yacht to yacht and are described on the offer page before you pay. If you book more than 14 days in advance, you can cancel your booking free of charge with a full refund within 72 hours of booking. After this time the charter company’s terms and conditions will apply. We therefore recommend that you take out a travel insurance policy that also covers cancellation of your trip. The refundable security deposit is always returned to the client, as long as there was no damage to the yacht.

seoSection.intro: A yacht charter can turn a holiday into a voyage. boat4you brings thousands of charter yachts from around the world into one search, with live online booking availability and charter prices, and the obligatory extras and deposit are listed before you pay. For every yacht on offer online there are detailed equipment lists and real yacht photos. Sailing yachts, catamarans, motor yachts and even gulets can be easily compared side by side and booked online within minutes.

blocks.heading: Bareboat, skippered or fully crewed
blocks.body: Depending on your personal preferences and requirements you can book a bareboat or add a skipper to your yacht. If you hold a recognised sailing licence (e.g. Croatian boat licence, RYA Day Skipper, ICC etc.) you can book a bareboat and set off on your sailing holiday. If not, you can always add a skipper at the online checkout. For a completely relaxing holiday you can also book a crewed yacht with skipper and hostess, who will take care of everything from the cooking to planning your routes.

blocks.heading: Sailing yacht, catamaran or motor yacht
blocks.body: Sailing yachts are great for the sailor looking for the purest form of sailing at the best price per berth. Catamarans are very popular for family sailing as they don’t heel and offer private cabins in both hulls and a saloon the whole crew fits into. Motor yachts are ideal for those who wish to cover a lot of miles during the day, about twice as many as a sailing yacht. Traditional gulets are offered with a professional crew and give a very romantic experience of sailing on wooden decks. Every listing on boat4you shows cabins, berths, build year and the obligatory extras before you book.

blocks.heading: Where and when to set sail
blocks.body: In the Mediterranean the charter season is from April till end of October. July and August bring plenty of sunshine and the liveliest harbours, but yacht charter prices are at their highest then. In May, June and September the sea water is still warm and the winds are more stable, while prices are noticeably lower than in the peak season. From November till end of April the charter fleet moves to the Caribbean, the Bahamas and the Seychelles while Europe awaits the next sailing season. Most charters run from Saturday to Saturday out of well-connected home marinas, so flights and transfers are easy to plan.

seoSection.closing: So you want to book a sailing holiday? Just pick your destination above, compare prices for your dates on the yachts of your choice, and book online within minutes in a secure environment. Should you have any questions before, during or after your online booking, we are here to help you.
